title: Perpetual Ltd Sells 45,191 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Oct 27th, 2018 // No Comments
Perpetual Ltd reduced its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 70.3% in the second quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 19,070 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 45,191 shares during the quarter. Perpetual Ltd’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,536,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
A number of other large investors have also recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Asset Management Advisors LLC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 8.0% in the 1st quarter. Asset Management Advisors LLC now owns 42,537 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,137,000 after acquiring an additional 3,165 shares during the period. Marco Investment Management LLC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 13.7% in the 1st quarter. Marco Investment Management LLC now owns 161,415 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $27,082,000 after acquiring an additional 19,438 shares during the period. Pegasus Asset Management Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.1% in the 1st quarter. Pegasus Asset Management Inc. now owns 25,514 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,281,000 after acquiring an additional 528 shares during the period. FormulaFolio Investments LLC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 3.4% in the 1st quarter. FormulaFolio Investments LLC now owns 26,041 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,369,000 after acquiring an additional 867 shares during the period. Finally, Wedbush Securities Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 3.9% in the 1st quarter. Wedbush Securities Inc. now owns 164,675 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $27,629,000 after acquiring an additional 6,168 shares during the period. 58.51% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Several analysts have recently commented on the stock. BTIG Research upgraded shares of Apple to a “buy” rating and raised their target price for the stock from $207.00 to $235.00 in a research note on Wednesday, August 1st. Macquarie set a $214.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, August 15th. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and issued a $232.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, August 22nd. S&P Equity Research raised their target price on shares of Apple to $250.00 and gave the stock an “in-line” rating in a research note on Tuesday, September 11th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Finally, UBS Group assumed coverage on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 12th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating and thirty-one have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $224.63.
In other news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, October 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total transaction of $5,816,500.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $24,554,471.08. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213 over the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $216.30 on Friday. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $150.24 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The stock has a market cap of $1,080.35 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 23.49, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.36.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same period last year, the firm posted $1.67 EPS. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. On average, research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.77 EPS for the current year.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
